new_source.description: The new source code that was written to the cell

old_source.description: The previous cell source (replace/delete only). Enables cell-relative diff rendering without re-reading the notebook.

cell_id.description: The ID of the cell that was edited

language.description: The programming language of the notebook

edit_mode.description: The edit mode that was used

error.description: Error message if the operation failed

notebook_path.description: The path to the notebook file

original_file.description: The original notebook content before modification

updated_file.description: The updated notebook content after modification
